KB_Config.Description: Traffic Pattern Anomaly Detection - Monitors both request frequency and data transfer volume by user agent

Query_Elastic.query: FROM .ds-kibana_sample_data_logs-* | WHERE @timestamp >= '2025-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' AND @timestamp < '2025-11-01T00:00:00.000Z' | EVAL es_timestamp = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp) | STATS request_count = COUNT(*), avg_bytes_per_request = AVG(bytes) BY es_timestamp | SORT es_timestamp
